title: New Family of Luminescent Tetranuclear Lanthanide-Based Germsesquioxanes: Luminescence and Temperature Sensing

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: tetraethylammonium bis[octaphenyl-octagermsesquioxane] tetraeuropium hexanitrate bis(ethanol) bis(acetonitrile) diacetonitrile solvate

synthesis.procedure: Compounds 1–5 were prepared analogously. [PhGeO1.5]n (prepared as previously described) and NaOH were dissolved in 30 mL of ethanol and heated to reflux for 1.0 h. A mixture of the lanthanide salt(s) and Et4NCl in 30 mL of MeCN was then added at once and the solution was refluxed for 3 h. Filtration from the insoluble residue gave a colorless solution. Slow evaporation of the ethanol/MeCN mixture over a few days afforded crystalline product; crystals suitable for SCXRD were collected and the bulk was dried in vacuum for analysis and yield. For 1: [PhGeO1.5] 0.139 g (0.8 mmol), NaOH 0.032 g (0.8 mmol), Eu(NO3)3·6H2O 0.178 g (0.4 mmol).
synthesis.time: 1.0 h (phenylgermanolate formation) then 3 h after Ln/Et4NCl addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: two-step reflux; in situ phenylgermanolate formation then reaction with Et4NCl and Eu(NO3)3
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration of insoluble residue; slow evaporation of ethanol/MeCN over a few days; vacuum drying of crystals

properties.summary: Solid-state Eu3+ photoluminescence at 298 and 77 K; direct 4f excitation dominates with only a weak ligand band. Emission under 395 nm shows 5D0→7F0–4 lines, most intense 5D0→7F2 at 612 nm (red). Weak 5D0→7F0 at 580 nm indicates low-symmetry Eu sites. Magnetic data were not reported for diamagnetic 1 (dc/ac studies described for 2–5).

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: tetraethylammonium bis[octaphenyl-octagermsesquioxane] tetraterbium hexanitrate bis(ethanol) bis(acetonitrile) acetonitrile solvate

synthesis.procedure: Same two-step reflux procedure as 1–5. Loadings for 2: [PhGeO1.5] 0.139 g (0.8 mmol), NaOH 0.032 g (0.8 mmol), Tb(NO3)3·6H2O 0.181 g (0.4 mmol). Et4NCl in MeCN added after the ethanolic phenylgermanolate reflux; 3 h additional reflux; filtration and slow evaporation of ethanol/MeCN.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: two-step reflux; in situ phenylgermanolate formation then reaction with Et4NCl and Tb(NO3)3
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration; slow evaporation of ethanol/MeCN; vacuum drying

properties.summary: Paramagnetic; room-temperature χT agrees with the theoretical value (Table S3). χT decreases on cooling (thermal depopulation and/or antiferromagnetic interactions). Magnetization at 1.8 K is S-shaped at low field, attributed to a spin-flip transition; saturation not reached up to 5 T (anisotropy). No ac slow relaxation. Solid-state Tb3+ luminescence: ligand band 310–390 nm plus 4f lines; emission under 325/377 nm dominated by 5D4→7F5 at 543 nm.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: tetraethylammonium bis[octaphenyl-octagermsesquioxane] dit terbium-dieuropium hexanitrate bis(ethanol) bis(acetonitrile) 2.5-acetonitrile solvate

synthesis.procedure: Same two-step reflux as 1–5 with Tb3+/Eu3+ feed ratio 2/2. Loadings: [PhGeO1.5] 0.139 g (0.8 mmol), NaOH 0.032 g (0.8 mmol), Tb(NO3)3·6H2O 0.095 g (0.2 mmol), Eu(NO3)3·6H2O 0.089 g (0.2 mmol). Et4NCl in MeCN added after 1 h ethanolic reflux; 3 h further reflux; filtration and slow evaporation. EDS Tb/Eu = 33.06/35.36.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: two-step reflux; mixed Tb/Eu nitrate feed
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration; slow evaporation of ethanol/MeCN; vacuum drying

properties.summary: Paramagnetic; χT vs T under 1000 Oe as for 2–5; linear then slow M(H) at 1.8 K; no ac slow relaxation. Dual Tb3+/Eu3+ emission with intramolecular Tb→Eu energy transfer. Self-referenced ratiometric thermometer using LIR of Tb 5D4→7F5 (530–560 nm) vs Eu 5D0→7F2 (604–642 nm) under 351 nm excitation (20–100 °C): Sr,max = 0.87 % °C−1 at 57.66 °C; maximal thermal uncertainty 0.034 °C.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: tetraethylammonium bis[octaphenyl-octagermsesquioxane] dysprosium-triyttrium hexanitrate bis(ethanol) bis(acetonitrile) diacetonitrile solvate

synthesis.procedure: Same two-step reflux as 1–5 with Dy3+/Y3+ feed ratio 1/3. Loadings: [PhGeO1.5] 0.139 g (0.8 mmol), NaOH 0.032 g (0.8 mmol), Dy(NO3)3·6H2O 0.048 g (0.1 mmol), Y(NO3)3·6H2O 0.102 g (0.3 mmol). Et4NCl in MeCN added after phenylgermanolate reflux; 3 h further reflux; filtration and slow evaporation. EDS Y/Dy = 32.24/10.64. (Experimental heading OCR sometimes shows Si; the compound is the germsesquioxane analogue.)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: two-step reflux; mixed Dy/Y nitrate feed
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration; slow evaporation of ethanol/MeCN; vacuum drying

properties.summary: Paramagnetic; χT vs T under 1000 Oe; M(H) at 1.8 K as for 3–5; no ac slow relaxation. Typical Dy3+ green-yellow emission without antenna effect. At 77 K, excitation monitored at 574 nm peaks at 350 nm (6H15/2→6P7/2); emission under 352 nm dominated by 4F9/2→6H13/2 (568–588 nm). High-resolution hypersensitive band indicates a Dy/Y solid solution.
